title: Draws
description:
See the complete draws for the 2025 tournament.

All of the draws and results for Roland Garros 2025 at a glance: men’s singles, women’s singles, qualifying rounds, men’s doubles, women’s doubles, mixed doubles, boys’ and girls’ singles and doubles, Legends Trophy, wheelchair and quad tennis. Don’t miss any of the tournament’s results, right from the draw until all of the competitions are complete.
